scope: Read-only evidence audit of Qwen2.5-VL 3B/7B VideoChatGPT KVRepack parameter experiments; no new model generations or judge calls.

metric_definitions.primary: Arithmetic mean of correctness, detailed_orientation, context, temporal, consistency (five equally weighted metrics). Existing summaries use average_5_metrics.
metric_definitions.equal_three_tasks_secondary: Arithmetic mean of [mean(correctness,detailed_orientation,context), temporal, consistency]. This is a different derived metric and can change Hybrid7B ranking.
metric_definitions.consistency_n: 200 generated consistency rows become 100 paired-video judge units; total judge units 3*200+200+100=900.

ranking_policy: Requested/response GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4-mini are not pooled.
Primary descriptive table uses complete full200 runs and canonical GPT-5.4-mini evaluations.

Generic posthoc and single-output shared-cache use the same prompt-building/parse functions and resolved model gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17; cache policies/batches remain explicit, and best_by_protocol is separately provided.
Repeated judges of identical generated samples are retained as repetitions and are not treated as new parameter configurations.
Six-/sixteen-/selected preservation/gain subsets are not ranked as full200; LookM missing cells remain explicit.
An observed maximum is bounded by the inspected local candidates; it is not proof of global hyperparameter optimality.

judge_code_evidence.meaning: shared-cache uses the generic judge module, identical generic/consistency prompts and five-metric average
